prompt:
## Resumo
A dark, aurora-glow testimonial CAROUSEL section for a prompt-to-UI design product. Under a sticky glass nav, a centered header (a small live-dot 'Loved by 57,000+ builders' badge, an Inter+Space-Grotesk headline whose tail 'staring at blank canvases' is painted in an aqua->sky->magenta aurora gradient, a muted subhead) sits above the carousel stage. The stage is one large glass 'stage-card' (rounded-[2rem], dual radial aqua/magenta tints + a blurred aurora glow halo behind it) carrying the active testimonial: an avatar with an aqua->magenta gradient ring, a name + role (the company name in aqua), a five-star magenta rating, a big Space-Grotesk pull-quote, a hairline divider, and a footer row of pill/pill-pip pagination dots (the active dot a stretched aqua->magenta gradient pill) on the left and prev/next round arrow buttons on the right (prev = glass, next = solid white). Two blurred, rotated 'ghost' peek cards float (CSS keyframe) behind the stage on large screens to sell the carousel motif. Below, a three-up trust-stats strip (4.9/5, 120k+, 9x) on a hairline top border. A faint SVG grain + two big ambient aqua/magenta blur globs sit fixed behind everything. Vanilla JS drives slide state (data array, paint/render with a fade-up transition, dot + arrow handlers) and the mobile hamburger menu. Space Grotesk (display) + Inter (body), Phosphor icons inline.

## Estilo Visual
Design a premium dark 'aurora glass' testimonial carousel section for a prompt-to-UI SaaS, using Space Grotesk for display text (headline, pull-quote, name, big stat numbers; weights 400/500/600/700) and Inter for all body/label text. Palette: ink background #0b0f14; accent aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9, and a sky midpoint #7dd3fc; text in a slate scale (slate-200 body, slate-300/400 muted) with white reserved for emphasis. Use ONLY aqua + magenta (+ the sky midpoint) as hues, never a third color. Ground the page in #0b0f14 with two fixed ambient blur globs (one aqua/10 ~420px top-left, one magenta/10 ~480px right-of-center, each blur ~140-150px) plus a fixed fractal-noise SVG grain (feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.85, 2 octaves) at opacity ~0.025; add a ::selection of aqua/30. The hero accent is .aurora-text: a linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #7dd3fc 45%, #e879f9 100%) background-clipped to transparent text, applied to the headline tail. Glass utilities: .glass = rgba(255,255,255,0.03) fill + backdrop-blur(14px) + 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07) border; .nav-glass = rgba(11,15,20,0.6) + backdrop-blur(18px) saturate(140%) + 1px bottom border rgba(255,255,255,0.06). The carousel .stage-card layers radial-gradient(120% 140% at 0% 0%, rgba(45,212,191,.16)->0 42%) + radial-gradient(120% 140% at 100% 100%, rgba(232,121,249,.18)->0 46%) over linear-gradient(160deg,#11161d,#0c1117), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08) border, and a layered shadow 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.8) + two inset highlights; behind it a .stage-glow = radial aqua/35 (top-left) + radial magenta/38 (bottom-right) at blur(60px). Ghost peek cards (.ghost-card) are dark glass gradients with a heavier shadow, rotated +/-6deg, blurred 0.5px, floating on @keyframes floaty (translateY 0->-10px, 7s and 9s ease-in-out infinite). The avatar gets an aqua->magenta gradient ring blob behind a ring-2 ring-ink circle. Stars are magenta ph:star-fill; the active pagination dot is a stretched (h-2 w-7) aqua->magenta gradient pill, inactive dots are h-2 w-2 white/20, transitioning width over .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). Prev button is .glass round (hover border aqua/40, hover text aqua); next button is solid white text-ink (hover bg aqua); both active:scale-95. Keep motion subtle (floaty cards, quote fade-up, press scale), keep it nocturnal, high-craft and a touch playful, never flat or garish.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) styled .nav-glass = rgba(11,15,20,0.6) + backdrop-blur(18px) saturate(140%) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06) bottom border. Inside a max-w-7xl row, h-16, items justify-between, px-6/lg:px-8: left = a logo lockup = a rounded-xl tile (h-9 w-9, place-items-center) with an aqua->magenta gradient fill and a soft aqua shadow holding an ink-colored Phosphor ph:sparkle (18px), beside a Space Grotesk 'Promptfold' wordmark (text-lg font-600, white, tracking-tight); center = medium slate-400 links 'Library', 'Canvas', 'Pricing' and a white active 'Voices' (gap-9, text-sm, hidden below md, hover:text-white); right = a 'Sign in' slate-300 ghost link (hidden below sm) and a solid white rounded-full 'Start free' pill (px-4 py-2, text-sm font-600 text-ink, hover:bg-aqua). On mobile a .glass rounded-xl hamburger button (h-10 w-10, md:hidden) toggles between a ph:list and ph:x icon and shows/hides a slide-down menu panel (border-t, bg-ink/95, backdrop-blur-xl) listing the nav links + 'Sign in' as full-width rows with hover:bg-white/5.

### Section header
A centered header block capped at max-w-2xl. (1) A status badge: an inline-flex rounded-full chip with a white/10 border + white/3 fill, px-3.5 py-1.5, text-xs font-500 tracking-wide slate-300, holding a 1.5x1.5 aqua dot with an aqua glow shadow (shadow-[0_0_8px_2px_rgba(45,212,191,0.7)]) + the text 'Loved by 57,000+ builders'. (2) A Space Grotesk headline (mt-5-ish, text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl, font-600, leading-[1.08], tracking-tight, white) reading 'Designers who stopped' then a line break and the tail 'staring at blank canvases' wrapped in <span class=aurora-text> (the aqua->sky->magenta clipped gradient). (3) A muted subhead (mt-5, max-w-lg, text-base leading-relaxed slate-400): 'Real teams shipping real UI from a single prompt. No frameworks to fight, no boilerplate to babysit.'

### Carousel stage card
The carousel stage in a relative max-w-4xl block (mt-16). Behind it sit two floating ghost peek cards (.ghost-card, lg:block only, pointer-events-none): one -left-24/xl:-left-32 top-10 -rotate-6 and one -right-24/xl:-right-32 bottom-8 rotate-6, each h-60 w-72 rounded-3xl p-6 opacity-70 blur-[0.5px] floating on the floaty/floaty-2 keyframes, with a thin colored side bar (aqua/60 left, magenta/60 right), a big ph:quotes glyph (aqua/45 or magenta/45), a small slate-300 quote line and a slate-400 byline. A blurred .stage-glow halo sits -inset-6 -z-10 opacity-70 behind. The MAIN stage is a <figure class='stage-card'> (relative z-10 overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] px-8 py-12 -> sm:px-14 sm:py-14): a faint Space-Grotesk closing-quote glyph (text-[12rem]->sm:[16rem], white/4) bleeds off the top-right; inside, top to bottom: an avatar+meta row, a big quote, a gradient hairline divider, and a dots+arrows footer.

### Avatar, meta + star rating
Inside the stage card, an avatar+meta row (flex items-center gap-4). Left: the avatar = a relative inline-block with an absolute -inset-0.5 rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient ring (opacity-80, blur-[1px]) behind a relative h-14 w-14 rounded-full object-cover img with a ring-2 ring-ink. Beside it: a Space Grotesk name (id=t-name, text-base font-600 white) and a role line (id=t-role, text-sm slate-400) where the company name is wrapped in <span class=text-aqua>, e.g. 'Lead Product Designer - Northwind'. Pushed to the right (ml-auto, hidden below sm, flex gap-1): a five-star rating of magenta ph:star-fill icons (16px), labelled aria 'Rated 5 out of 5 stars'.

### Pull-quote + divider
A big pull-quote blockquote (id=t-quote, mt-8, Space Grotesk display, text-2xl -> sm:text-[2rem]/leading-[1.3] -> lg:text-[2.15rem], font-500, leading-[1.32], tracking-tight, white) carrying the active testimonial, e.g. '"I described a dashboard in two sentences and Promptfold handed me a full, on-brand layout I could actually ship. It is the first design tool that keeps up with how fast I think."'. Below it (mt-9) a divider = an h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent.

### Pagination dots + arrows footer
A footer row (mt-7, flex items-center justify-between). Left: a #dots flex (gap-2.5) of pagination dots built in JS, one per slide: the active dot is a stretched h-2 w-7 rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient pill, inactive dots are h-2 w-2 rounded-full white/20, all with a .dot transition (all .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)) so width animates; each is a button with aria-label 'Go to slide N'. Right: two round 44px (h-11 w-11) arrow buttons (gap-3): prev = .glass rounded-full text-slate-200 (hover:border-aqua/40 hover:text-aqua, active:scale-95) with a ph:arrow-left; next = solid bg-white text-ink rounded-full (hover:bg-aqua, active:scale-95) with a ph:arrow-right; both aria-labelled.

### Trust-stats strip
Below the stage (mt-20), a three-up trust-stats strip capped at max-w-3xl: a grid-cols-3 gap-6 on a border-t border-white/6, pt-10, text-center. Each cell: a Space Grotesk text-3xl font-600 white number with a colored suffix span, then a mt-1 text-xs font-500 slate-400 label. The three cells: '4.9' + aqua '/5' / 'avg. rating'; '120k' + magenta '+' / 'designs shipped'; '9' + aqua 'x' / 'faster handoff'.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Aurora gradient text: .aurora-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #7dd3fc 45%, #e879f9 100%) background-clipped to transparent, painting the headline tail 'staring at blank canvases'

### Componente
Glass stage-card: a rounded-[2rem] carousel card layering two radial color tints (aqua top-left, magenta bottom-right) over a dark linear gradient, with a 1px white/8 border and a deep layered shadow + inset highlights

### Componente
Stage-glow halo: a separate blurred (blur 60px) radial aqua/35 + magenta/38 glow sitting -inset-6 -z-10 behind the stage card

### Componente
Floating ghost peek cards: two dark-glass rounded-3xl mini testimonial cards rotated +/-6deg, blurred, floating on @keyframes floaty (translateY 0->-10px, 7s / 9s ease-in-out infinite), shown only at lg+ to sell the carousel depth

### Componente
Aurora avatar ring: an absolute -inset-0.5 rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient blob (opacity-80, blur-[1px]) behind the ring-2 ring-ink avatar circle

### Componente
Animated pagination dots: JS-built dots where the active one is a stretched h-2 w-7 aqua->magenta gradient pill and inactive are h-2 w-2 white/20, with a .35s width transition

### Componente
Two-tone arrow controls: a .glass prev button (hover border/text aqua) paired with a solid white next button (hover bg-aqua), both round h-11 w-11 with active:scale-95

### Componente
Magenta five-star rating: a row of five ph:star-fill magenta icons (hidden below sm) in the stage card header

### Componente
Faint serif quote-mark motif: an oversized text-[12rem]->[16rem] closing-quote glyph (.quote-mark, Space Grotesk) in white/4 bleeding off the stage card's top-right

### Componente
Live-dot badge: a rounded-full glassy chip with a glowing aqua dot (shadow-[0_0_8px_2px_rgba(45,212,191,0.7)]) reading 'Loved by 57,000+ builders'

### Componente
Trust-stats strip: a three-up max-w-3xl grid on a hairline top border with Space-Grotesk numbers and aqua/magenta suffix accents (4.9/5, 120k+, 9x)

### Componente
Sticky glass nav + mobile menu: a .nav-glass header (ink/60 blur saturate) with an aqua->magenta gradient logo tile, and a .glass hamburger toggling a slide-down ink/95 backdrop-blur menu panel (ph:list <-> ph:x)

### Componente
Ambient backdrop: two fixed aqua/10 + magenta/10 blur globs plus a fixed fractal-noise SVG .grain at ~2.5% opacity behind the whole page

### Componente
Vanilla-JS carousel engine: a data[] array of {name, role, quote, img}, a paint() that writes the active slide into the DOM, a render() that cross-fades the quote up (opacity + translateY over .4s) on change, go()/prev/next handlers with wraparound, and an on-load paint to guarantee inline HTML matches data[0]

## Notas Especiais
Fonts via Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display: headline, pull-quote, name, stat numbers, the big quote-mark glyph) and Inter (sans: body, labels, badges), weights 400/500/600/700. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: fontFamily.sans = Inter, fontFamily.display = Space Grotesk; colors ink #0b0f14, aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9 (the sky midpoint #7dd3fc is used inline in the aurora gradient). Body background #0b0f14, html scroll-behavior:smooth, ::selection aqua/30. Custom CSS utilities: .aurora-text (the 100deg aqua->sky->magenta clipped gradient), .glass (white/3 + blur 14px + white/7 border), .nav-glass (ink/60 + blur 18px saturate 140% + bottom hairline), .stage-card (dual radial tints over dark linear gradient + layered shadow), .stage-glow (radial aqua/magenta glow at blur 60px), .ghost-card (dark glass gradient + heavy shadow), .quote-mark (Space Grotesk serif-ish, line-height 0.7), .dot (all .35s cubic-bezier transition), .grain (inline fractal-noise SVG data URI), and @keyframes floaty + .floaty/.floaty-2 (7s/9s). Icons are inline Phosphor SVG paths (sparkle, list/x hamburger, quotes, star-fill, arrow-left, arrow-right) using fill=currentColor, not an icon library import. The carousel is driven by vanilla JS: a data[] array, buildDots()/paint()/render()/go() with wraparound, prev/next + dot click handlers, an on-load paint() to avoid a flash/mismatch, and a mobile-menu setMenu() toggle. The signature moves are the aurora-gradient headline + accents, the glass stage-card with its glow halo and floating rotated ghost peek cards, the animated aqua->magenta pagination pill, and the two-tone (glass / solid-white) arrow controls over a grain + ambient-glob dark ground. Keep the palette strictly aqua + magenta (+ sky midpoint) over the ink/slate dark scale, never introduce a third hue.

Below the stage (mt-20), a three-up trust-stats strip capped at max-w-3xl: a grid-cols-3 gap-6 on a border-t border-white/6, pt-10, text-center. Each cell: a Space Grotesk text-3xl font-600 white number with a colored suffix span, then a mt-1 text-xs font-500 slate-400 label. The three cells: '4.9' + aqua '/5' / 'avg. rating'; '120k' + magenta '+' / 'designs shipped'; '9' + aqua 'x' / 'faster handoff'.

special_ui_components.prompt: Aurora gradient text: .aurora-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #7dd3fc 45%, #e879f9 100%) background-clipped to transparent, painting the headline tail 'staring at blank canvases'

Glass stage-card: a rounded-[2rem] carousel card layering two radial color tints (aqua top-left, magenta bottom-right) over a dark linear gradient, with a 1px white/8 border and a deep layered shadow + inset highlights
Stage-glow halo: a separate blurred (blur 60px) radial aqua/35 + magenta/38 glow sitting -inset-6 -z-10 behind the stage card

Floating ghost peek cards: two dark-glass rounded-3xl mini testimonial cards rotated +/-6deg, blurred, floating on @keyframes floaty (translateY 0->-10px, 7s / 9s ease-in-out infinite), shown only at lg+ to sell the carousel depth
Aurora avatar ring: an absolute -inset-0.5 rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient blob (opacity-80, blur-[1px]) behind the ring-2 ring-ink avatar circle
Animated pagination dots: JS-built dots where the active one is a stretched h-2 w-7 aqua->magenta gradient pill and inactive are h-2 w-2 white/20, with a .35s width transition
Two-tone arrow controls: a .glass prev button (hover border/text aqua) paired with a solid white next button (hover bg-aqua), both round h-11 w-11 with active:scale-95
Magenta five-star rating: a row of five ph:star-fill magenta icons (hidden below sm) in the stage card header
Faint serif quote-mark motif: an oversized text-[12rem]->[16rem] closing-quote glyph (.quote-mark, Space Grotesk) in white/4 bleeding off the stage card's top-right
Live-dot badge: a rounded-full glassy chip with a glowing aqua dot (shadow-[0_0_8px_2px_rgba(45,212,191,0.7)]) reading 'Loved by 57,000+ builders'
Trust-stats strip: a three-up max-w-3xl grid on a hairline top border with Space-Grotesk numbers and aqua/magenta suffix accents (4.9/5, 120k+, 9x)

Sticky glass nav + mobile menu: a .nav-glass header (ink/60 blur saturate) with an aqua->magenta gradient logo tile, and a .glass hamburger toggling a slide-down ink/95 backdrop-blur menu panel (ph:list <-> ph:x)
Ambient backdrop: two fixed aqua/10 + magenta/10 blur globs plus a fixed fractal-noise SVG .grain at ~2.5% opacity behind the whole page

Vanilla-JS carousel engine: a data[] array of {name, role, quote, img}, a paint() that writes the active slide into the DOM, a render() that cross-fades the quote up (opacity + translateY over .4s) on change, go()/prev/next handlers with wraparound, and an on-load paint to guarantee inline HTML matches data[0]

structured.special_notes: Fonts via Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display: headline, pull-quote, name, stat numbers, the big quote-mark glyph) and Inter (sans: body, labels, badges), weights 400/500/600/700. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: fontFamily.sans = Inter, fontFamily.display = Space Grotesk; colors ink #0b0f14, aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9 (the sky midpoint #7dd3fc is used inline in the aurora gradient). Body background #0b0f14, html scroll-behavior:smooth, ::selection aqua/30. Custom CSS utilities: .aurora-text (the 100deg aqua->sky->magenta clipped gradient), .glass (white/3 + blur 14px + white/7 border), .nav-glass (ink/60 + blur 18px saturate 140% + bottom hairline), .stage-card (dual radial tints over dark linear gradient + layered shadow), .stage-glow (radial aqua/magenta glow at blur 60px), .ghost-card (dark glass gradient + heavy shadow), .quote-mark (Space Grotesk serif-ish, line-height 0.7), .dot (all .35s cubic-bezier transition), .grain (inline fractal-noise SVG data URI), and @keyframes floaty + .floaty/.floaty-2 (7s/9s). Icons are inline Phosphor SVG paths (sparkle, list/x hamburger, quotes, star-fill, arrow-left, arrow-right) using fill=currentColor, not an icon library import. The carousel is driven by vanilla JS: a data[] array, buildDots()/paint()/render()/go() with wraparound, prev/next + dot click handlers, an on-load paint() to avoid a flash/mismatch, and a mobile-menu setMenu() toggle. The signature moves are the aurora-gradient headline + accents, the glass stage-card with its glow halo and floating rotated ghost peek cards, the animated aqua->magenta pagination pill, and the two-tone (glass / solid-white) arrow controls over a grain + ambient-glob dark ground. Keep the palette strictly aqua + magenta (+ sky midpoint) over the ink/slate dark scale, never introduce a third hue.
